decisions.reason: As a newly launched underground mining loader that fits the firm’s engineering-focused strategy and was already publicly presented on the website, management would likely continue backing it because investment and commitment are recent and any weak early response can still be seen as temporary.

As a newly launched underground mining dump truck closely aligned with the firm’s stated direction in specialized, safety-oriented underground equipment and already publicly signaled to the market, management would likely persist rather than withdraw after only a short time.
